title: Design session
description: The append-only record a design session keeps, stored inside the registry worktree at `<Source>/.worktrees/<project>/registries/decisions/<surface>.json`. Rounds are appended, never edited: an accepted round is evidence, and feedback opens the next round instead of rewriting the last. A candidate body is written once to `objects/sha256/<hash>.json` and referenced by hash from then on, so a round can cite a proposal without copying it — and two rounds proposing the same thing cite one object.

project.description: Declared by the user and resolved through the workspace route, never inferred from a folder.

surface.description: Session identity IS the surface. A reworded prompt is a new round, not a new session.

queue.description: Pending decisions. Durable, which is why it lives in `registries` and not in the disposable `sessions` root.

chain.description: Seals the rounds. `head` is the hash of the last sealed round and `sequence` counts them, so a round edited in place stops matching the chain — the property the round array alone cannot have. Mirrors `registry.json` at the registry root, which seals every session in the project the same way.

prompt.description: The exact request or feedback that opened this round.

layoutHash.description: Present for block rounds: the accepted parent layout. This is a dependency edge, not part of the independently hashed anatomy.

directionReview.description: Present on a layout round while the owner compares no-hash direction choices.

produced.description: Empty only while a direction review is still open; layout and block candidates are stored by hash once produced.

hash.description: Of the canonical candidate, never of a rendered page. The body lives at `objects/sha256/<hash>.json`; this is the reference to it.

refusal.description: The product decision this round could not make.

rejected.description: The actual proposal refused, its replacement, and the owner's reason in their words. Never reconstructed from memory.

sealed.description: The chain value after this round was appended. Absent on the round still open.

candidates.description: The exact transient choices shown to the owner. They carry no approval hash.

feedback.description: The owner's words when feedback opens the next direction review.

layoutHash.description: Required for block decisions: the accepted layout that makes this block reachable.

state.description: Also the directory the reference sits in.

supersededBy.description: The accepted replacement; required when state is superseded.

queued.description: One pending or settled decision. Its `state` is also its place on disk: a reference file under `layouts/<state>/<hash>.ref` or `blocks/<state>/<hash>.ref`, so the directory listing and this array cannot disagree without one of them being wrong out loud.
